claims.claim_text: The entity discloses metrics and targets used to measure and monitor sustainability-related risks and opportunities that could reasonably be expected to affect the entity’s prospects, including metrics required by applicable IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards and metrics the entity uses to measure and monitor the risk/opportunity and performance (including progress towards targets and any legally required targets).
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Metrics and targets (opening paragraph and bullets)
claims.support_notes: Text mirrors IFRS S1 paragraph 46 clauses (a), (b)(i) and (b)(ii) at a high level; no entity-specific metrics/targets are provided.

claims.claim_text: When a metric is taken from a source other than IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards, the entity identifies the source and the metric taken.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Identification and sourcing of metrics (bullet 1)
claims.support_notes: Requirement is stated as a policy/commitment; no examples of external-source metrics or named sources are included.

claims.claim_text: In the absence of an IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standard that specifically applies to a sustainability-related risk or opportunity, the entity applies relevant IFRS S1 requirements to identify applicable metrics.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Identification and sourcing of metrics (bullet 2)
claims.support_notes: Draft references applying IFRS S1 requirements; IFRS S1 requirement specifically references paragraphs 57–58.

claims.claim_text: Metrics disclosed include metrics associated with particular business models, activities or other common features that characterise participation in an industry.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Identification and sourcing of metrics (bullet 3)
claims.support_notes: Stated as an inclusion principle; no industry-specific metric list is provided.

claims.claim_text: If a metric has been developed by the entity, the entity discloses how the metric is defined, including whether it is derived by adjusting a metric from a non-IFRS source and how it differs from that source metric.
claims.support_notes: Requirement is described; no entity-developed metric definitions or reconciliations are included.

claims.claim_text: If a metric has been developed by the entity, the entity discloses whether the metric is an absolute measure, a measure expressed in relation to another metric, or a qualitative measure.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Entity-developed metrics (Type of measure bullet)
claims.support_notes: Stated as required disclosure; no classification of any specific metric is provided.

claims.claim_text: If a metric has been developed by the entity, the entity discloses whether the metric is validated by a third party and, if so, which party.
claims.support_notes: Requirement is stated; no third-party validator names are provided.

claims.claim_text: If a metric has been developed by the entity, the entity discloses the calculation method and inputs, including limitations and significant assumptions.
claims.support_notes: Requirement is stated; no calculation methodologies or assumptions are included.

claims.claim_text: The entity discloses information about targets it has set to monitor progress towards achieving strategic goals and any targets it is required to meet by law or regulation.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Targets (first bullet list under Targets)
claims.support_notes: High-level statement aligns with IFRS S1 paragraph 51 scope; detailed per-target items are listed separately in the draft.

claims.claim_text: For each target, the entity discloses the metric used to set the target and to monitor progress towards reaching the target.
claims.support_notes: Requirement is stated; no target-specific metric identifiers are provided.

claims.claim_text: For each target, the entity discloses the specific quantitative or qualitative target it has set or is required to meet.
claims.support_notes: Requirement is stated; no numeric/qualitative target values are included.

claims.claim_text: For each target, the entity discloses the period over which the target applies.
claims.support_notes: Requirement is stated; no target periods (years/dates) are provided.

claims.claim_text: For each target, the entity discloses the base period from which progress is measured.
claims.support_notes: Requirement is stated; no base period is specified.

claims.claim_text: For each target, the entity discloses any milestones and interim targets.
claims.support_notes: Requirement is stated; no milestones/interim targets are listed.

claims.claim_text: For each target, the entity discloses performance against the target and an analysis of trends or changes in performance.
claims.support_notes: Requirement is stated; no performance results or trend analysis is included.

claims.claim_text: For each target, the entity discloses any revisions to the target and explains those revisions.
claims.support_notes: Requirement is stated; no revisions are described.

claims.claim_text: The definition and calculation of metrics (including metrics used to set targets and monitor progress) are applied consistently over time.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Consistency and comparability of metrics over time (bullet 1)
claims.support_notes: Stated as a consistency principle; no evidence of historical application is provided.

claims.claim_text: If a metric is redefined or replaced in the reporting period, the entity discloses a revised comparative amount (unless impracticable), explains the changes, and explains the reasons for those changes.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Consistency and comparability of metrics over time (bullet 2)
claims.support_notes: Draft captures the B52 disclosure package at a high level; no actual redefinition/replacement event is described.

claims.claim_text: If new information is identified relating to an estimated amount disclosed in the preceding period and it provides evidence of circumstances that existed in that period, the entity discloses a revised comparative amount, the difference between the previously disclosed amount and the revised comparative amount, and the reasons for revising the comparative amount.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Consistency and comparability of metrics over time (bullet 3)
claims.support_notes: Draft aligns with IFRS S1 B50(a)-(c); no estimated amounts or revisions are presented.

claims.claim_text: The entity labels and defines metrics and targets using meaningful, clear and precise names and descriptions.
claims.support_notes: Requirement is stated; the draft does not include actual metric/target labels to assess clarity/precision.
